name: Barycentric Mapping for Material Interfaces (2D Triangular Grids)
definition: A method to determine material interface line segments within a 2D triangular grid cell by mapping the triangle's barycentric coordinates to a reference barycentric triangle and intersecting with Voronoi cell boundaries.
summary: Barycentric Mapping reconstructs material interfaces in 2D triangular grids by mapping volume fractions to barycentric space and intersecting with Voronoi boundaries, distinguishing itself from isosurface extraction by operating directly on unstructured mesh data.
